verdict.rationale: Gecko documents its own API keys, which can be named and are visible to the team with owner attribution and usage logging. Nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be limited by scope, permission, resource or read-only role for an agent. The 'scoped, auto-rotating access' line describes Gecko's own access into GitHub through the GitHub App, not credentials a user issues to an agent, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
